topic: Eye makeup hygiene: kajal/eyeliner sharing, old mascara, remove before sleep

youtube.title: Stop sharing kajal! Eye makeup rules 💄 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Sharing kajal or eyeliner? Here's why you should stop.
காஜலை மற்றவருடன் பகிர வேண்டாம்!

• Eyelids carry germs; a shared kajal pencil, eyeliner or mascara can spread eye infections.
• One person, one set: never share eye makeup, even with family.
• Eye experts advise replacing mascara about every 3 months; germs can grow inside the tube.
• Sharpen pencils before each use; apply liner outside the lash line, not on the inner rim (it can block oil glands).
• Never sleep in eye makeup; remove it gently every night with a clean cotton pad.
• If eyes turn red, painful, swollen or sticky: stop eye makeup, throw it away and see an eye doctor.
• General education only.

gmb.text:
Eye makeup hygiene: simple rules for healthy eyes. Your eyelids carry germs, so sharing kajal, eyeliner or mascara, even with family, can spread eye infections. Keep one set per person.

Eye experts advise replacing mascara about every 3 months. Sharpen pencils before each use and apply liner outside the lash line rather than on the inner rim, where it can block tiny oil glands. Never sleep in eye makeup; remove it gently every night.

If your eyes turn red, painful, swollen or sticky, stop using eye makeup, throw it away and see an eye doctor. Book an eye test on WhatsApp: 044 4356 9998
